newsitem.title: UK: Hilton leads Lonrho hotel race - paper.
newsitem.headline: Hilton leads Lonrho hotel race - paper.

text.p: Hilton Hotel Corporation (HHC) of the U.S. is seen as the front-runner to buy the Princess hotel chain from Lonrho in a deal which could be worth 400 million stg, the Sunday Times newspaper reported.
Last week UK conglomerate Lonrho said it had received interest from potential buyers for its Metropole and Princess hotels and was delaying their planned flotation.

The Sunday Telegraph also reported HHC as the frontrunner for the Princess hotels, but said the price could reach 500 million stg. It said Millennium & Copthorne Hotels was in talks to buy the Metropole chain for 250 million stg.
Lohnro officials were immediately unavailable for comment on the reports.
The Metropole, which has five locations in London, Birmingham, Brigton and Blackpool, is a four-star chain with extensive conference facilities.
Princess hotels include resorts in Acapulco, Mexico, the Caribbean and the United States.
